hooks.name: Domain Fast Check on Save
hooks.description: Routes saved files to domain-specific fast checks: UI/CSS → verify:focss + lint:ui:strict, DB → typecheck, Planner/Studio → scan:boundaries, Tests → typecheck:tests, fallback → typecheck.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $input.filePath; if ($f -match 'focss|components|\.css|postcss|tailwind') { pnpm run verify:focss; pnpm run lint:ui:strict } elseif ($f -match 'supabase|drizzle|migrations|scripts[\\/]db_') { pnpm run typecheck } elseif ($f -match 'lib[\\/]ai|mastra|advisor|lancedb|rag') { pnpm run typecheck } elseif ($f -match 'lib[\\/]seo|robots|sitemap|analytics|routeMetadata') { pnpm run typecheck } elseif ($f -match 'tests[\\/]|vitest|playwright') { pnpm run typecheck:tests } elseif ($f -match 'Planner|ooplanner') { pnpm run scan:boundaries } elseif ($f -match 'Studio|oostudio') { pnpm run scan:boundaries } elseif ($f -match 'app[\\/]api|lib[\\/]api|lib[\\/]auth|lib[\\/]security|rateLimit|safe-action') { pnpm run typecheck } else { pnpm run typecheck }"
